faq: No. You supply finished posts, or order our post design, video edit and content plan services. This service loads and schedules what exists.
Which scheduling tools do you use?
Meta Business Suite, Buffer, Later, Metricool and similar tools. We pick the one that suits your channels and budget, and you pay the tool directly if it is a paid plan.
Will scheduled posts reach fewer people?
No. Platforms treat scheduled posts from approved tools the same as manual ones. Some features, such as trending audio, may need to be added in the app by you.
What if I want to change a post after it is scheduled?
You can edit or delete it in the tool, or send us the change within your revisions. We leave a note in the calendar where something needs your last-minute check.
